column2: The agent prepares the request pack. It never provisions, extends or revokes access in a system.
Standard roles need the line manager named on the identity register. A peer or the requestor cannot approve.
Follow the extra approvers on the role catalogue, including IT security for privileged roles.
Access must have an end date no later than the contract end date. Open-ended contractor access is not drafted as ready.
All roles are proposed for revocation on or before the last working day. Late revokes are escalated.
A request that would break an SoD rule is stopped and sent to the process owner. It is not drafted as ready to provision.
